metadata.question: Was the PM2.5 level higher in February 2020 than in February 2019 within a 50km radius of (40.923221, 104.238631)?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Need PM2.5 data. GEE has the "COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_AER_AI" collection for aerosol data, but PM2.5 specifically might need different approach. There's also "MODIS/061/MCD19A2_GRANULES" for AOD which can be converted to PM2.5. Let me use the S5P collection which has aerosol_index data that correlates with particulate matter. 2. Masking strategy: For aerosol data, I'll use the QA band to filter good quality pixels. 3. Logic: Compare mean aerosol index values for Feb 2019 vs Feb 2020 within 50km radius of the given point. Let me structure this: - Create 50km buffer around the point - Get S5P data for Feb 2019 and Feb 2020 - Check if collections are empty - Calculate mean aerosol index for each period - Compare values to determine if 2020 was higher ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([104.238631, 40.923221]); const region = point.buffer(50000); // 50km radius // 2. Data Acquisition const feb2019 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_AER_AI') .filterDate('2019-02-01', '2019-03-01') .filterBounds(region); const feb2020 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_AER_AI') .filterDate('2020-02-01', '2020-03-01') .filterBounds(region); // Check collection sizes const count2019 = feb2019.size().getInfo(); const count2020 = feb2020.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Feb 2019 Images: ${count2019}`); console.log(`Feb 2020 Images: ${count2020}`); if (count2019 === 0 || count2020 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Create mean composites and mask poor quality const composite2019 = feb2019 .select('aerosol_index') .mean() .updateMask(feb2019.select('qa_value').mean().gt(0.5)); const composite2020 = feb2020 .select('aerosol_index') .mean() .updateMask(feb2020.select('qa_value').mean().gt(0.5)); // 4. Calculate statistics const stats2019 = composite2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2020 = composite2020.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const mean2019 = stats2019.get('aerosol_index').getInfo(); const countPixels2019 = stats2019.get('aerosol_index_count').getInfo(); const mean2020 = stats2020.get('aerosol_index').getInfo(); const countPixels2020 = stats2020.get('aerosol_index_count').getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Mean AI: ${mean2019?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels: ${countPixels2019}`); console.log(`2020 Mean AI: ${mean2020?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels: ${countPixels2020}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (countPixels2019 === 0 || countPixels2020 === 0) { console.log("C2"); } else if (mean2019 === null || mean2020 === null || isNaN(mean2019) || isNaN(mean2020) || mean2019 > 10 || mean2020 > 10) { // Unrealistic aerosol index values console.log("C3"); } else if (mean2020 > mean2019) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
